name: nGZSceneGraph::cImageData::ReleaseFrontElements (vf15)
notes: 172 bytes, ret 4 (n), void result. Releases up to n elements from the front of the current entry: Release (slot 2) on each element's virtual base at +0x1c, the count drops by one, and the first index advances (or resets to 0 when the count reaches zero). ORIGINAL-BUG (marked in src): a count of n not below the entry's element count releases count - 1 elements, so the last one is kept; with count 0 and n nonzero the original loops about 4 billion times, which the test avoids. The EH frame is unwind-only (1 state, no catch): the replacement has no frame, so if Release throws the original's cleanup state is not reproduced (not tested). The n == 0 path leaves an old fs:[0] value in eax; the result is void and not compared. Hooked (CRC 0xe5783442), not yet run in-game. Test: 2000 fixtures, fake Release logs (object, slot), some null elements. Mutants (count > 1, keep all, slot 1, +0x20 base) killed.
